name: Enuncia

phase_0.boundary_condition: The semantic field of a completed speech act

VINIT.justification: The state of potentiality before articulation

TANCH.justification: The terminal boundary of a grammatical unit

AFWD.justification: The movement from subject to predicate

AREV.justification: The descent from root to base form

IMSCRIB.justification: The speaker recognizing the utterance as their own

FSPLIT.justification: The split into literal and figurative interpretations

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the original intent from dual interpretations

EVALF.justification: The negative evaluation of a malformed sentence
